review_notes: I read the whole 57-line file and grepped the repo for repeated blocks. The only repeated proof machinery tied to this file is the local `htan : Measurable Real.tanh` proof in `magneticScalarSquareFourJet_sandwich`. The same four-line proof appears in about 30 other places, and I confirmed that with grep. The other declarations are a `choose` definition, a `choose_spec` wrapper, and a one-line forwarding theorem. They contain no repeated reasoning. Uncertainty: the repeated reasoning is a short measurability argument, which the rubric treats as a weak case. I did not check the exact import order, so where the shared lemma should live is a suggestion. I could not run Lean, so the rewritten use has not been compiled.

findings.excerpt:
have htan : Measurable Real.tanh := by
    change Measurable (fun x : ℝ => Real.tanh x)
    simp only [Real.tanh_eq]
    fun_prop
findings.problem: This block proves `Measurable Real.tanh` by unfolding `tanh` to a quotient of `sinh` and `cosh`, then running `fun_prop`. Every file in the Magnetic and Fields families re-derives it. Examples are `MagneticSlabZero` (twice), `MagneticScalarSlabEndpoint`, `MagneticScalarThird`, `MagneticScalarFourth`, `MagneticScalarContinuation`, `MagneticFiniteFourth` and `MagneticLevelModulus`. Eight files wrap it in their own private copies: `magnetic_tanh_measurable`, `field_measurable_tanh`, `measurable_field_tanh`, `measurable_tanh` and others. `FieldEndpointSampling` already has a public `field_tanh_measurable`, but it sits in a file that these modules do not import, so each one pastes the proof again. Some copies differ only in binder name (`x` or `z`), and `FieldFiniteFamily` uses a different proof. Maintainers must keep about 30 copies in sync, and each lemma that needs `htan` carries four lines of boilerplate.
findings.proposed_change: Move one public lemma, `lemma field_tanh_measurable : Measurable Real.tanh`, to a low-level shared file. Candidates are the file defining `field_abs_tanh_le_one` (`FieldSpinFolding`) or the file defining `measurable_logCosh`. It would keep the proof `change Measurable (fun x : ℝ => Real.tanh x); simp only [Real.tanh_eq]; fun_prop`, and this is the existing `FieldEndpointSampling` lemma relocated. Then delete the private copies and the inline `have`s. Here the block becomes `have hm := fieldScalarSquares_monotone L hL measurable_logCosh logCosh_linearGrowth field_tanh_measurable field_abs_tanh_le_one z ...`, and the later `htan` argument is replaced the same way. Every other site gets the same one-line substitution.
findings.benefit: There would be one proof of tanh measurability instead of about 30. Lemma bodies in this file and elsewhere shrink and show only their own mathematics. A future change to the proof, such as a Mathlib lemma becoming available, is made in one place. The private duplicates, which already have four different names, would go away.
